subject.title: refactor(net): extract guarded one-hop dispatch boundary

question: Should `network-guard/v1` become a maintained internal cross-owner contract in `src/infra/net`, or should this remain a local fetch-guard extraction until an approved second connection owner exists?
rationale: The profile serializes security-policy conclusions and names future cross-owner use, so the correct owner and compatibility expectations cannot be inferred safely from the patch alone.

options.title: Approve the internal contract
options.body: Confirm `src/infra/net` owns the versioned profile and require real direct/proxy behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Keep the boundary local
options.body: Remove the standalone versioned contract and retain only the behavior-preserving extraction until an approved consumer needs it.

recommendation.title: Approve the internal contract
recommendation.body: Confirm `src/infra/net` owns the versioned profile and require real direct/proxy behavior proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Their adjacent managed-egress work is the only supplied evidence of ownership over the related transport-policy boundary.
